seed_sweep.interpretation: No acceptance row is permanently below the waveform floor across the five tested seed schedules, but 75/125 rows are seed-sensitive. Selecting a lucky seed is not evidence of robust acceptance.

noise_ablation.interpretation: Duration noise contributes to some failures but is not the sole cause. Lowering/removing latent noise catastrophically suppresses amplitude, so inference tuning alone cannot establish a robust promotable candidate.

coverage_relation.interpretation: Default low-level failure is about three times more common on acceptance rows outside the 128-row R1 training selection, consistent with incomplete generalization from the phone-balanced warm-up.

training_trace_context.interpretation: Training did not globally diverge, but fixed-seed row-level amplitude degradation occurred despite a healthy median probe.

piper_transfer_boundary.r1_loop_behavior: The custom R1 loop then optimized all model_g parameters with the normal generator optimizer.
piper_transfer_boundary.hypothesis: R1 may have mixed successful DWC text/duration adaptation with avoidable drift in warm-start acoustic modules. This must be tested inference-only before corrective training.

governed_disposition.next_safe_test: Inference-only acoustic reset hybrid: retain learned R1 text-side weights, restore pristine warm-start decoder and/or flow modules, compare multi-seed waveform robustness.
do_not: choose a lucky inference seed as acceptance
